name: coffee after death?
source:
Short dating sim where you meet the embodiment of death on your way to the afterlife (and maybe take it out for some coffee - all that paperwork gets tiring sometimes, after all.)

[From [url=https://raazberry.itch.io/coffee-after-death]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
短暂的约会模拟游戏，你在通往来世的路上遇到了死亡的化身（也许还可以带它出去喝杯咖啡——毕竟，所有的文书工作有时会让人厌倦。）

[来自[url=https://raazberry.itch.io/coffee-after-death]Itch.io[/url]]
